query: What praise and complaints appear in IMDb reviews?

per_column.name: overall_sentiment_polarity
per_column.rationale: Overall positive/negative/mixed polarity is a summary aggregate of the whole praise-and-complaints concept, not a distinct part of it. It restates the net valence rather than isolating a constituent aspect.

per_column.name: praise_dimension
per_column.rationale: The specific dimension being praised (acting, story, writing, direction, etc.) is a genuine constitutive part of what 'praise' consists of within the concept.

per_column.name: complaint_dimension
per_column.rationale: The specific dimension being complained about is a genuine constitutive part of the 'complaints' half of the concept, and is meronymically 'an aspect of' the concept.

per_column.name: emotional_engagement
per_column.rationale: Emotional engagement (strongly engaging / off-putting / flat) is a substantive experiential aspect that reviews praise or complain about; it is a part-of the audience reaction rather than an external predictor.

per_column.name: comparative_reference_type
per_column.rationale: How a review frames praise/complaint via comparison (favorable/unfavorable, sequel, genre benchmark) is a rhetorical facet of how praise and complaints are expressed.

per_column.name: audience_recommendation_stance
per_column.rationale: The recommend/avoid stance is a downstream summary conclusion that follows from the praise and complaints rather than a constitutive part of them; it restates the net evaluative outcome.

judge.rationale: Four of six columns are genuine facets that carve the concept into non-overlapping constitutive aspects: what is praised, what is complained about, emotional engagement, and comparative framing. Two columns fail the meronymy test: overall_sentiment_polarity and audience_recommendation_stance are summary/restatement aggregates of the whole concept rather than parts of it. Mutual exclusivity is weakened because praise_dimension and complaint_dimension share nearly identical category vocabularies (acting, writing, story, direction, pacing, production_values) and emotional_engagement overlaps with the 'emotional_resonance' praise dimension and with the restatement columns' valence signal. Exhaustiveness is reasonably good for the praise/complaint content axes but the facet coverage is diluted rather than extended by the two non-facet summary columns.
